name: nettohelder
description: Dutch gross-to-net salary, 550+ CAO pay scales and 2026/2027 tax figures. Offline, TOON output.
long_description: Bruto-netto calculations for Dutch employment income on the same engine and data as [nettohelder.nl](https://nettohelder.nl). Tax years 2026 (confirmed) and 2027 (provisional, Belastingplan 2027), 550+ CAOs with salary tables, pension, bonus, overtime, part-time hours, 30%/27%-regeling and loonheffingskorting. Every tax figure carries its official source URL. Runs fully offline: no network access, no API key. Results are TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation).

tools.name: bereken_netto
tools.description: Gross to net for one Dutch employment income, by monthly or annual salary or a CAO position, with a step-by-step breakdown and the source of every figure.

tools.name: zoek_cao
tools.description: Search CAOs with salary data by name, sector or salary kind.

tools.name: cao_details
tools.description: Terms, pension fund, allowances and salary tables of one CAO.

tools.name: vergelijk_jaren
tools.description: The same calculation for 2026 and 2027 side by side, with the difference.
